description: This PHP source file defines the class ImportMapOther, which handles import settings for standard delimited files in the SuiteCRM project. It includes properties for import configuration and methods for retrieving field mappings based on module types, as well as ignored fields.

classes.name: ImportMapOther
classes.description: A class that encapsulates import settings such as delimiters and field mappings for different modules in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getMapping
methods.description: Returns an associative array mapping imported field names to database fields for a specified module.

methods.name: getIgnoredFields
methods.description: Returns an array of fields that should be ignored during import for a specified module.
